items.exampleEn: My grandmother always whipped eggs by hand, without a machine.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶總是用手打蛋，不用機器。

items.exampleEn: My teacher does not tolerate talking during tests.
items.exampleZh: 我的老師不容許考試時講話。

items.exampleEn: Would you like your eggs fried or scrambled?
items.exampleZh: 你的蛋要煎的還是炒的？

items.exampleEn: He punched the bag hard during his boxing class.
items.exampleZh: 他在拳擊課上用力打沙包。

items.exampleEn: She persisted with her piano practice even when it was hard.
items.exampleZh: 即使很辛苦，她還是堅持練鋼琴。

items.exampleEn: She exploited every chance to practice her English.
items.exampleZh: 她利用每一個機會練習英文。

items.exampleEn: Bright colors stimulate babies' interest in toys.
items.exampleZh: 鮮豔的顏色能引起嬰兒對玩具的興趣。

items.exampleEn: He was sacked for always arriving late.
items.exampleZh: 他因為老是遲到被開除了。

items.sentenceEn: Whip the cream until it is thick, then add the sugar.
items.sentenceZh: 把鮮奶油打到變稠，再加糖。

items.audioEn: Please punch two holes in each page so we can put them in the folder.
items.audioZh: 請在每一頁打兩個洞，這樣我們才能把它們放進資料夾。

items.sentenceEn: The new park will stimulate the local economy.
items.sentenceZh: 新公園將會刺激地方經濟。

items.sentenceEn: I can't tolerate loud music when I'm trying to sleep.
items.sentenceZh: 我想睡覺的時候受不了很大聲的音樂。

items.stemEn: If the rain ____, the match will be cancelled.
items.stemZh: 如果雨一直下，比賽就會取消。

items.stemEn: The company wants to ____ the wind on the coast to make electricity.
items.stemZh: 那家公司想利用海岸的風來發電。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our hiking club climbed a steep hill near the city. Near the top, we had to scramble over large rocks using our hands. One member could not tolerate the heat and wanted to stop, but the rest of us persisted, and she joined us again after a short rest. At the top, someone punched the air with joy. Our leader explained that the town below once exploited the hill for its stone, but today a city project protects the area. The beautiful view stimulated a long discussion about protecting nature. Before going down, we ate cake with whipped cream that someone had carried up in a cool box.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們健行社爬了城市附近的一座陡峭小山。快到山頂時，我們得手腳並用爬過大石頭。有一位社員受不了炎熱想停下來，但其他人堅持往上爬，她休息一下後又跟上了我們。到了山頂，有人開心地揮拳慶祝。領隊說，山下的小鎮以前曾開採這座山的石頭，但現在市政府的一項計畫保護著這一帶。美麗的景色引發了一場關於保護自然的長時間討論。下山前，我們吃了有人用保冷箱背上來、加了打發鮮奶油的蛋糕。

questions.questionZh: 快到山頂時大家必須怎麼做？
那座山以前被鎮上用來做什麼？

items.promptZh: 那家工廠上個月開除了十名員工。
referenceEn: The factory sacked ten workers last month.
Last month, the factory sacked ten of its workers.
rubricZh: 時態合理（例如 sacked、fired 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 scramble 造一個句子，說說你看過大家爭搶某樣東西的情況。
referenceEn: People scrambled for seats when the train doors opened.
Shoppers scrambled for cheap shoes on the first day of the sale.
rubricZh: scramble 的用法，例如 scramble for seats、scramble to get… 等
時態配合內容（例如 scrambled、scramble 等）
